title: See an agent work · louis-agent
text: Watch the agents at work. Each demo is a real run, recorded once and played back. Nothing runs while you watch, and every word on screen is what the agents said. Made-up businesses, real agents: this is what a website with an agent does for yours. seemeeu.example Seemeeu Guesthouse Home Rooms Stay Four rooms, five minutes from the beach. Breakfast on the stoep from 07:30. Dogs welcome in the garden room. Ask Seemeeu Hi, do you have a sea-view room for this Friday and Saturday night? We are two, and we would like to bring our dog. Dogs are only welcome in the garden room, a double with its own gate to the fenced garden, at R1,250 a night plus R150 for your dog, so the sea-view doubles (R1,450 a night) can't take your dog. The garden room R1,250 a night Type your question wheatfieldkitchen.example Wheatfield Kitchen Home Menu Visit Country cooking from the Swartland's own farms. Lunch Tuesday to Sunday, 12:00 to 15:00. Dinner Thursday to Saturday. Ask Wheatfield Hi, are you open for lunch on Sunday? We are a family of five, with two small kids. We're open for lunch on Sunday from 12:00 to 15:00, and the children's menu is R75 a dish. For the children Menu Type your question koringland.example Koringland Attorneys Home What we do Consultations Wills, property and family law, in English and Afrikaans. Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00. At the office or by video call. Ask Koringland Good morning. I need to change my will after my divorce. What should I put in it? What goes in your will is advice I can't give, but the page's "After a divorce" section explains how the law treats a will made before a divorce, so I'll open it for you.
